note: Candidate questions for 1.3 fine-tuning training data. Each is checked against the real PDF chunks (same PyPDFLoader + RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(1500/200) as rag_backend.py) by prepare_finetune_data.py before being trusted. anchors are short lowercase phrases; a chunk counts as a match if it contains at least one anchor after the same normalization rag_evaluation.py uses (lowercase, whitespace-collapsed). None of these questions duplicate the held-out 25-case data/retrieval_eval.json benchmark - that file must stay untouched by training. (2026-09-16: 4 anchors revised - app-2/app-7/app-10/app-13 had matched the wrong provision on the first pass; new anchors are unverified proposals, confirmed only if prepare_finetune_data.py actually finds them in a real chunk.)

candidates.question: What must an APP entity's information-handling practices, procedures and systems achieve under APP 1?
anchors: will ensure that the entity complies with the australian privacy principles
reasonable in the circumstances to implement practices, procedures and systems

candidates.question: When is an APP entity not required to allow an individual to deal with it anonymously or under a pseudonym?
anchors: impracticable for the app entity to deal with individuals who have not identified themselves
option of not identifying themselves, or of using a pseudonym

candidates.question: By what means must an APP entity collect personal information?
anchors: must collect personal information only by lawful and fair means

candidates.question: From whom must an APP entity collect personal information about an individual, where reasonably practicable?
anchors: collect personal information about an individual only from the individual
unreasonable or impracticable to do so

candidates.question: What must an APP entity do with unsolicited personal information it could not have collected under APP 3?
anchors: destroy the information or ensure that the information is de-identified

candidates.question: What matters must an APP entity's notification under APP 5 ordinarily cover?
anchors: identity and contact details of the app entity

candidates.question: When may an APP entity use personal information for a secondary purpose without the individual's consent?
anchors: directly related to the primary purpose
reasonably necessary for one or more enforcement related activities

candidates.question: When may an organisation use personal information for direct marketing without the individual's consent?
anchors: simple means by which the individual may easily request not to receive direct marketing

candidates.question: What exceptions allow an APP entity to disclose personal information overseas without ensuring the recipient complies with the APPs?
When may an organisation use or disclose a government related identifier of an individual?
anchors: government related identifier of an individual

candidates.question: What quality steps must an APP entity take before using or disclosing personal information?
anchors: personal information that the entity uses or discloses is, having regard to the purpose of the use or disclosure
accurate, up to date, complete and relevant

candidates.question: Within what timeframe must an APP entity respond to a request for access to personal information?
anchors: reasonable period after the request is made
respond to the request for access

candidates.question: May an APP entity charge an individual for giving access to their personal information?
anchors: give access to the personal information

candidates.question: What must an APP entity do if it corrects personal information it had previously disclosed to another entity?
How does the Privacy Act define personal information?
anchors: information or an opinion about an identified individual, or an individual who is reasonably identifiable

candidates.question: How is consent defined for the purposes of the Privacy Act?
When is personal information de-identified under the Privacy Act?
anchors: no longer about an identifiable individual or an individual who is reasonably identifiable

candidates.question: What counts as a generally available publication under the Privacy Act?
anchors: generally available to members of the public

candidates.question: When does an entity collect personal information under the Privacy Act?
anchors: collects the personal information for inclusion in a record or generally available publication

candidates.question: What does Part IIIC of the Privacy Act cover?
How is 'entity' defined for the purposes of the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme?
When is an entity taken to hold personal information for the purposes of Part IIIC?
What exception applies to an entity's assessment obligation when another entity has already dealt with an eligible data breach?
anchors: eligible data breaches of other entities

candidates.question: What exception to notifying an eligible data breach applies for enforcement related activities?
When may the Commissioner direct an entity to notify an eligible data breach?
What is the civil penalty provision for interference with the privacy of individuals?
anchors: civil penalty provision for interference with privacy of individuals

What are the functions of the Information Commissioner under the Privacy Act?
How may a complaint be made to the Commissioner under the Privacy Act?
What can the Commissioner determine after investigating a complaint under the Privacy Act?
What is an enforceable undertaking under the Privacy Act?
When may an injunction be sought under the Privacy Act?
What is an infringement notice under the Privacy Act?
What restrictions apply when a credit reporting body collects credit information?
What must a credit provider disclose about an individual's financial hardship information?
How may an individual access credit eligibility information held about them by a credit provider?
